However, its potential for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity (CMR), environmental impact, endocrine disruption (EDC), dermal and eye irritation, and organ/systemic toxicity remains largely unknown, as these categories are all designated Tier 4 due to insufficient data.
